ynamides react with TCNE to provide high yields of substituted TCBDs.
ynamide-TCNE cycloadducts undergo a retroelectrocyclization reaction to afford TCBD species in a high-yield manner.

the synthesis of substituted TCBD species, and we have developed a high-yielding method for their preparation from the reaction of ynamide derivatives with TCNE.

TCNE is a versatile reagent to form a variety of substituted TCBD species from reaction with ynamides.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ynamides are excellent substrates for the formation of TCBDs.
ynamides can be converted into TCBD species with high yields and in a one-step process.
ynamide-TCNE cycloadducts are highly unstable and undergo a facile retroelectrocyclization to give TCBDs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the reaction is a high-yielding and versatile process that can be used to synthesize TCBDs in high yields from ynamides.
the reaction of ynamide with TCNE is a viable alternative to the reaction of yne-1,2-amines with TCNE for the synthesis of TCBD species.
